records.context: A fixed 96 by 96 source window starts at the rounded table centroid minus 48; cells whose window crosses the available microscope field of view context are excluded. ``radius`` is a dilation of the own nucleus mask by one Euclidean disk, independent of that window. Funk defaults use the nucleus mask. Pixels outside the dilation are black, while neighbouring objects inside it remain visible.
records.label: spacr.ops_cell_cycle.write_label_queue#1
records.source: A fixed 96 by 96 source window starts at the rounded table centroid minus 48; cells whose window crosses the available field context are excluded. ``radius`` is a dilation of the own nucleus mask by one Euclidean disk, independent of that window. Funk defaults use the nucleus mask. Pixels outside the dilation are black, while neighbouring objects inside it remain visible.
records.translation: Una ventana de origen fija de 96 por 96 comienza en el centroide de la tabla redondeado, menos 48; se excluyen las células cuya ventana sobrepasa el contexto de campo disponible. ``radius`` corresponde a una dilatación de la máscara del núcleo propio de la célula mediante un único disco euclídeo, independiente de esa ventana. Los valores predeterminados de Funk usan la máscara del núcleo. Los píxeles fuera de la dilatación son negros, mientras que los objetos vecinos situados dentro siguen siendo visibles.

records.context: The panels show grey DNA, grey tubulin and their blue-DNA/green-tubulin composite with a zero red image data channel. Each panel is enlarged threefold with nearest neighbours, followed by a one-pixel yellow own-mask outline. Two four-pixel grey separators give a tile of 872 by 288 pixels. A white 10 µm scale bar requires explicit source pixel calibration; no physical size is inferred from image dimensions.
records.label: spacr.ops_cell_cycle.write_label_queue#2
records.source: The panels show grey DNA, grey tubulin and their blue-DNA/green-tubulin composite with a zero red channel. Each panel is enlarged threefold with nearest neighbours, followed by a one-pixel yellow own-mask outline. Two four-pixel grey separators give a tile of 872 by 288 pixels. A white 10 µm scale bar requires explicit source pixel calibration; no physical size is inferred from image dimensions.
records.translation: Los paneles muestran DNA en gris, tubulina en gris y su composición de DNA azul/tubulina verde con el canal rojo a cero. Cada panel se amplía al triple mediante interpolación por el vecino más cercano y después se dibuja un contorno amarillo de un píxel de la máscara propia del objeto. Dos separadores grises de cuatro píxeles dan una tesela de 872 por 288 píxeles. Una barra de escala blanca de 10 µm requiere una calibración explícita del píxel de origen; no se infiere ningún tamaño físico de las dimensiones de la imagen.

records.context: The fixed Funk display bounds are DAPI 550–23,039 and GFP 1,084–5,002 in raw uint16 units. ``ranges`` overrides these bounds in selected-image data channel order; no extracted image region or annotation work list statistics are used. Opaque PNG names map exactly to cells in the separate ``queue.csv`` manifest, which must stay outside blind inputs. Annotation 1 to 7 follows :data:`CLASSES`.
records.label: spacr.ops_cell_cycle.write_label_queue#3
records.source: The fixed Funk display bounds are DAPI 550–23,039 and GFP 1,084–5,002 in raw uint16 units. ``ranges`` overrides these bounds in selected-channel order; no crop or queue statistics are used. Opaque PNG names map exactly to cells in the separate ``queue.csv`` manifest, which must stay outside blind inputs. Annotation 1 to 7 follows :data:`CLASSES`.
records.translation: Los límites de visualización fijos de Funk son DAPI 550–23,039 y GFP 1,084–5,002 en unidades uint16 sin procesar. ``ranges`` sustituye estos límites en el orden de los canales seleccionados; no se utilizan estadísticas de los recortes ni de la cola. Los nombres opacos de los PNG se corresponden exactamente con las células en el manifiesto separado ``queue.csv``, que debe mantenerse fuera de las entradas usadas para la anotación a ciegas. La anotación de 1 a 7 sigue :data:`CLASSES`.
